title: Reinforced Netherite And More
description: Don't want your two week Minecraft phase to end? Reinforced Netherite And More solves YOUR boredom with custom OP effect YOU truly EARN !
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88b9b6981641fc9be90099fe7e29faceb6dde8e0_0.webp)Don't want your two week Minecraft phase to end? Don't have anything to grind for after obtaining netherite armor? Want to achieve true power? Well, don't worry anymore, because, I introduce to you _"Reinforced Netherite And More"_ with custom **OP** effect to feel truly overpowered

## Features:
- Reinforced netherite helmet: gives effect of waterbreathing I when worn.
- Reinforced netherite chestplate: gives effect of resistence I and fire resistence II when worn.
- Reinforced netherite leggings: gives effect of absoption I when worn
- Reinforced netherite boots: gives effect of speed II and jumpboost I when worn.
- Reinforced netherite pickaxe: gives effect of haste I when held in hand.
- Reinforced netherite axe: gives effect of haste I and strength I when held in hand.
- Reinforced netherite sword: gives effect of strength I when held in hand.
- Reinforced netherite shovel: gives effect of haste I when held in hand.
- Reinforced netherite hoe: gives effect of hero of the village I when held in hand.
- Reinforced netherite shield: doesn't have special propreties other than the multiplied durability value
> (check the [changelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-netherite-and-more/changelog) for more info)

Dependencies:
1. [Fabric api](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-netherite-and-more/changelog) (required)
2. [Roughly Enough Items (REI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) (recommended)
